title: Cadence 3.10 is here
body:
Modes. One switch that sets Cadence up for what you are doing. Study has a focus timer you can share in a session. Dev pings you when your AI is done. Inspiration shows a quote, picture or clip of yours when no music is playing.

Stage is open to everyone now, in Settings, Effects.

Your data. You can delete your account, listen along is encrypted, and there is a privacy page that says what Cadence does. Everyone in a listen along session needs this version.
